definitions.candidate: a transaction whose json view is a single legacy System transfer with 1 signer and 3 static keys - the only shape the v0 envelope can address
definitions.grant: built FROM the transaction under test (its own signer, destination, amount) - a best-case grant, NOT a statement about any grant that would be issued
definitions.approved: the PRODUCT policy (src/policy.js evaluate) returned allowed for those wire bytes
definitions.pairing: the json signature bytes must occur in the base64 wire bytes of the same index; unpaired rows are counted and excluded from per-transaction verdicts

limits: Best-case grants: this measures whether the daemon COULD sign, not whether any grant would be issued.
A bounded window of finalized mainnet blocks, not a census.
One RPC node, one moment; the window is minutes wide.
No user, no audit, no real funds.
